name: create_reminder
description: Create reminder(s) that can trigger TTS notifications. Use when user says: 'remind me', 'set a reminder', 'add to calendar', 'schedule', 'create event', 'calendar event', etc. IMPORTANT: Supports bounded daily spans in a SINGLE call. Examples: 'next 5 days at 2pm', 'for the next 5 days at 2pm', '5 days in a row at 2pm', 'every day for 5 days at 2pm', 'every day the next 2 weeks at 5pm'. Do NOT split bounded daily requests into separate one-time plus recurring reminders unless the user explicitly asks for separate reminders. Also supports: 'in 30 minutes', 'tomorrow at 3pm', 'May 1st at 6pm', 'next month on the 1st at 6pm', 'every Wednesday at 2pm' (weekly), 'every month on the 10th' (monthly), 'every day at 2pm' (daily recurring).

description.description: Optional additional details about the reminder

when.description: Natural time expression. Bounded daily spans: 'next 5 days at 2pm', 'for the next 5 days at 2pm', '5 days in a row at 2pm', 'every day for 5 days at 2pm', 'every day the next 2 weeks at 5pm' (creates multiple reminders from ONE tool call). One-time: 'in 30 minutes', 'tomorrow at 3pm', 'May 1st at 6pm', 'next month on the 1st at 6pm', 'at 5pm'. Recurring: 'every day at 2pm', 'every Wednesday at 2pm', 'every month on the 10th'. Use the user's natural phrasing.
